evals.prompt: Break this approved PRD into GitHub implementation tickets.
evals.expected_output: Creates an approved, acyclic set of independently verifiable vertical-slice tickets with observable outcomes, acceptance criteria, blockers, and source references.
assertions: Uses vertical slices rather than horizontal layer tickets
Requires user approval of granularity and dependencies
Uses neutral needs-triage status when the tracker supports states
Does not classify tickets by ownership

evals.prompt: Write a PRD for the billing export feature.
evals.expected_output: Does not create tickets; it identifies PRD synthesis as the appropriate task.
assertions: Does not trigger for PRD authoring
Does not publish tracker tickets from an underspecified request

evals.prompt: Migrate every client from API v1 to v2 and create the tickets now.
evals.expected_output: Proposes expand, migrate, and contract tickets with ordered dependencies, verifies each remains observable, and waits for approval before publishing.
assertions: Uses expand-migrate-contract for a broad compatibility change
Links expand before migrate before contract
Checks the dependency graph is acyclic
Does not publish before the user approves the breakdown
